excluded.HMBC: NOT exhaustively curated: only the two diagnostic glycosidic/ester linkage correlations are recorded (anomeric->linkage carbon). The angular-methyl->skeleton and sugar-ring HMBC network was not fully curated - see notes.
excluded.COSY: not curated: the terpene aliphatic envelope and overlapped sugar-ring CH make per-pair assignment unreliable for a molecule this size within budget.

notes: Massularoside - a triterpenoid (oleanane/ursane-type) bis-glycoside with a 3-O-linked 4-O-sulfated 6-deoxy-hexose and a 28-O-glucose ester. Solvent C5D5N (pyridine-d5). Large molecule (41 C, ~33 protonated) - PARTIAL curation of the confidently-resolved diagnostic signals only: two anomerics C33(glucose ester)=95.5/6.30 and C3(deoxysugar)=103.9/4.92; 6-deoxy sugar CH3 C0=18.3/1.55; glucose CH2OH ~62.1; sulfate-bearing sugar CH ~5.00/81.0; and 5 aglycone angular methyls (16.4/16.6/20.7/28.1/32.2, positions only - too degenerate to assign to specific atoms without full skeleton HMBC). Two glycosidic linkages verified by HMBC: glucose anomeric->28-COO ester C30(176.5); deoxysugar anomeric->aglycone C3 position (atom 5, 89.5). The dense terpene CH2 envelope and overlapped sugar-ring CH were not exhaustively curated. HSQC edited signs not reliable.
